kind: reviewer paraphrases of primary artist sources; no audio accessed

sources.observation: Istomin's account, written for a Sony reissue in 1990, describes forming the trio with Isaac Stern and choosing cellist Leonard Rose. This supports the exact collective membership, not an arbitrary ensemble-member substitution.

Artist site dates the trio's Mendelssohn Op66 recording to 19 and 20 July 1979 and names all three players. Source LP label dates 1966/1980 and cached ISRC year portions are not treated as exact session-date proof.

limits: No listening, exact-take or pressing/transfer verification. Collective decomposition remains a proposal; no production rule adopted.
